items.title: W.T. "Ed" Kirkeby Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: I picked up the Memphis Five with Philly Napoleon and Mip Mole and Frankie Signorelli and the clarinet... Lytel with them? Bert Lytel. That was the trumpet. What is Bert's right name? Jimmy. Jimmy Lytel.

ctx.x: Well, you were associated with a lot of jazz music after that. What was the next jazz band that you worked with?

Well, when I left Columbia, I went to the artist representation field, and I made records for many of the companies beside the big two, and I picked up the Memphis Five with Philly Napoleon and Mip Mole and Frankie Signorelli and the clarinet... Lytel with them? Bert Lytel. That was the trumpet. What is Bert's right name? Jimmy. Jimmy Lytel. Jimmy Lytel. Bert was the actor.
